{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute chi-squared manually for channel vs segment
observed = cross_tab_segment.values

total = observed.sum()
row_totals = observed.sum(axis=1)
col_totals = observed.sum(axis=0)
expected = np.outer(row_totals, col_totals) / total

# Chi-squared statistic
chi2 = np.sum((observed - expected) ** 2 / expected)

dof = (observed.shape[0] - 1) * (observed.shape[1] - 1)

# Approximate p-value using chi2 distribution (using np.random for simulation)
# Generate 100,000 random chi2 values with dof degrees of freedom
chi2_sim = np.random.chisquare(dof, size=100000)
p = np.mean(chi2_sim >= chi2)

chi2, p, p < 0.05"}
